base: branch f3/wp3-2-s4-srp-light-time from main 953f567 (merge of PR #123; contains S3, PR #124 cb9958d)
scope_decision: WP3.1-R decision 2026-11-08 (survey report section 9, 206cb69): SRP_LIGHT_TIME goes in opt-in as ONE package, the P-R force with the Sun at emission and the shadow with the Moon at the ray crossing delta = (r.u)/c, never one without the other (survey section 7 item 4: either part alone leaves a larger error than both out), after tide, albedo/IR and Earth shadow; defaults and frozen results unchanged. The predeclared occulter delta = |r|/c (3.07x too long at the 100 km contacts) must not be used
question: Does the production propagator, with the opt-in SRP light-time package, integrate WP3.1's ray-crossing SRP_LIGHT_TIME term (0.109 sigma in O2xE1, 0.101 in O3xE3), with position and velocity gradients and a K_SRP sensitivity that match it, light-time lunar contacts in the D2 segmentation, and a force direction and occulter position that agree with independent relativistic, SPICE and exact-ray oracles, without changing any existing path (default, tide-on, LRP-on or Earth-shadow-on)?

physics.model: WP3.1's ray-crossing SRP_LIGHT_TIME, unchanged (wp3_1_materiality_diagnostics.full_ray_crossing). In the J2000 frame at the Moon at time t (Moon-centred, SI): the Sun at emission r_emit = r_sun - v_sun tau with tau = |r_sc - r_sun|/c; the light direction u = (r_sc - r_emit)/d, d = |r_sc - r_emit|; the occulting Moon at its ray-crossing position r_occ = -v_moon delta with delta = (r_sc . u)/c; nu_LT = the production lunar illumination of srp.shadow_model with the Sun at r_emit and the Moon at r_occ (WP3.1's lunar_illumination: early exit nu = 1 when (r_sc - r_occ).(r_emit - r_occ) > 0, NO_SHADOW gives 1); the force a_LT = K P(d) nu_LT [(1 - v.u/c) u - v/c] (Poynting-Robertson, first order in v/c) with v = v_sc + v_moon - v_sun, v_sun and v_moon the SSB velocities of the Sun and the Moon (J2000, geometric) and v_sc the Moon-centred spacecraft velocity of the state. K = 0 and nu_LT = 0 give a_LT = 0
physics.form: production adds the increment da = a_LT - a_SRP to the existing SRP, a_SRP = srp_acceleration_with_lunar_shadow (geometric Sun and Moon). This is WP3.1's full_ray_crossing expression, so production equals the WP3.1 ray-crossing term bit for bit (LT_G2). With the S3 Earth shadow also on, the increment is multiplied by the geometric Earth illumination nu_E, so the total SRP is nu_E a_LT (occulters multiplied, as S3); the Earth shadow itself stays geometric (its ~38 km light-time displacement is out of scope)
physics.gradient: da depends on r_sc (through tau, u, d, delta and nu_LT) and, unlike every earlier force term, on the spacecraft velocity. Position: d(a_LT)/dr = K [P'(d) nu g (u^T J) + P g (grad nu_LT)^T + P nu ((1 - v.u/c) I - u v^T/c)(I - u u^T) J / d] with g = (1 - v.u/c) u - v/c, J = I + v_sun w^T/c (w the unit vector from the geometric Sun to the spacecraft, dr_emit/dr = -v_sun w^T/c), P' = -2P/d, and grad nu_LT = (dnu/dA)(dr_emit/dr - I) + (dnu/dB)(dr_occ/dr - I) with A = r_emit - r_sc, B = r_occ - r_sc, dr_occ/dr = -v_moon (u^T + r_sc^T (I - u u^T) J / d)/c; dnu/dA and dnu/dB are the conical-formula partials of srp._illumination_and_gradient's derivation split between the Sun and the occulter. The increment's gradient is d(a_LT)/dr - G_SRP. Velocity: d(da)/dv_sc = -K P nu_LT (u u^T + I)/c. Both enter the variational block: rows 3:6 of Phi_dot get G_r Phi[0:3, :] + G_v Phi[3:6, :]
physics.k: da is linear in K: its part of df/dK is (a_LT - a_SRP)/K evaluated K-free (the per-K kernels), so K = 0 stays legal; with the Earth shadow it is nu_E times that
physics.size: annual aberration tilts the force by v/c ~ 1e-4 rad (transverse 4.6e-12 m/s^2 at K = 0.01); the spacecraft's orbital velocity adds a drag (v_sc/c) a_SRP ~ 2.5e-13 m/s^2 at K = 0.01; the shadow lags the Moon by ~60 m, which moves each lunar contact of a 100 km orbit by ~0.11 s (WP3.1 6.2: exact closest approach -0.1118 s); the two parts nearly cancel in shadowed orbits (O3xE3: 0.47 and 0.57 sigma apart, 0.10 together)
physics.requirement: WP3.1's ray-crossing response is at most 0.109 sigma, so a model error that is a fraction f of the term moves the solution by ~0.109 f sigma; the gates below verify the term to f <= 1e-3 (force law and direction) and the occulter position to <= 0.1 m of its ~60 m lag (f <= 2e-3), far inside any materiality need
physics.known_model_limits: stated before any number: (1) WP3.1's v is relative to the Sun while u comes from the retarded (emission) Sun position, which counts the Sun's SSB motion twice: the force direction differs from the exact apparent direction by v_sun_perp/c <= ~5.2e-8 rad (|v_sun| <= ~15.5 m/s), 2e-15 m/s^2 at K = 0.01, ~5e-4 of the term; kept for parity with the decided model and bounded by LT_G3(b); (2) first order in v/c: the neglected (v/c)^2 terms are ~1e-8 of a_SRP; (3) the source-motion intensity factor (~v_sun/c ~ 5e-8 of a_SRP), gravitational light bending and the Earth shadow's light time are not modelled

design.validation: SSBVelocityTable: t_s 1-D strictly increasing finite with >= 2 samples, velocity arrays (N,3) finite (ValueError); SRPLightTimeOptions: ssb_velocities not an SSBVelocityTable (TypeError), provenance not a str (ValueError), positional construction (TypeError); a srp_light_time that is neither None nor SRPLightTimeOptions raises TypeError; at propagation a srp_light_time without an active SRPOptions (srp None or disabled) raises ValueError, because the package replaces the SRP force and has nothing to replace otherwise; non-finite inputs to the term raise ValueError
design.dynamics: dynamics._with_srp_light_time_acceleration(rhs, get_earth_pos, get_sun_pos, srp, srp_light_time, earth_shadow, *, state_size) returns rhs ITSELF when srp_light_time is None. Otherwise: 6-state adds da (times nu_E when earth_shadow is given) to elements 3:6 and never evaluates a gradient; 42-state also adds G_r @ Phi[0:3, :] + G_v @ Phi[3:6, :] to rows 3:6 of Phi_dot; 48-state also adds G_r @ s_K[0:3] + G_v @ s_K[3:6] + da_per_K to s_K_dot[3:6]. With the Earth shadow: G_r -> nu_E G_r + da (grad nu_E)^T, G_v -> nu_E G_v, da_per_K -> nu_E da_per_K. It is applied last, after the Earth-shadow wrapper, on every path (6-state, 42-state plain and harmonic, 48-state). The SSB velocities come from SRPLightTimeOptions.ssb_velocities at the propagation time t (the same time axis as get_sun_pos)

NO_SHADOW SRP has no lunar contacts, so the package adds none (_segmentation_active unchanged). With the package off the pre-pass events, the check function and every branch are the existing ones

gates.LT_G2_WP3_1_PARITY: 2000 samples, seed 20261127: 1000 'band' samples behind the Moon (Sun direction isotropic at distance uniform in [0.983, 1.017] AU; spacecraft at axial distance x uniform in [20, 3000] km on the anti-Sun side and perpendicular distance from the Sun-Moon axis uniform in [R_MOON - 30 km, R_MOON + 30 km], azimuth uniform) and 1000 'shell' samples (radius uniform in [R_MOON + 20 km, R_MOON + 3000 km], isotropic direction); v_sc isotropic with |v_sc| uniform in [0.5, 2.5] km/s, v_moon isotropic with |v_moon| uniform in [28.5, 31.5] km/s, v_sun isotropic with |v_sun| uniform in [0, 16] m/s. Production light_time_geometry equals wp3_1_materiality_diagnostics.ray_crossing_geometry and srp_light_time_increment equals full_ray_crossing bit for bit, for srp CONICAL_PENUMBRA and NO_SHADOW at K = 0.01, and srp_light_time_increment_and_jacobians returns the same da bit for bit. Precondition of the sample design: at least 300 lit (nu_LT = 1), 300 penumbral (0 < nu_LT < 1) and 300 umbral (nu_LT = 0) CONICAL samples
gates.LT_G3_ORACLES: (a) Lorentz oracle of the force law (independent derivation, no first-order formula): for a body absorbing the solar flux and re-emitting it isotropically in its rest frame, with u the light direction in the Sun frame and v the velocity relative to the Sun, the rest-frame flux is S' = S gamma^2 (1 - v.u/c)^2, the rest-frame light direction u' = (u - gamma v/c + (gamma - 1)(u.vhat) vhat) / (gamma (1 - v.u/c)), the rest-frame force F' = (S' A/c) u' with zero power, and the Sun-frame acceleration a_ref = (F' + (gamma - 1)(F'.vhat) vhat)/(m gamma), i.e. a_ref = K P(d) nu (gamma (1 - v.u/c)^2) [u' + (gamma - 1)(u'.vhat) vhat] with production's u, d and nu_LT. On the 1000 shell samples with nu_LT = 1 and on 200 further lit samples with |v| up to 31.5 km/s: max |a_LT,prod - a_ref| / |a_SRP| <= 1e-7 (neglected (v/c)^2 ~ 1e-8). Precondition: with v = 0 the oracle equals K P(d) u to <= 4 eps relative. Negative control: the geometric production SRP a_SRP differs from a_ref by >= 100x the gated maximum. (b) SPICE apparent-direction oracle: 200 epochs uniform in 2026 (seed 20261127), spacecraft in the sunward half (r_sc . r_sun > 0) with the shell sampler's radius and velocity laws; production force direction ahat = (da + a_SRP)/|da + a_SRP| with v_sun, v_moon from spkezr; reference -p/|p| with p = spkcvo('SUN', et, 'J2000', 'OBSERVER', 'CN+S', [r_sc, v_sc] in km and km/s, et, 'MOON', 'J2000'), the apparent Sun seen by the moving spacecraft. Gate: max angle <= 1.5e-7 rad (known_model_limits (1) predicts <= 5.2e-8, plus SPICE's first-order stellar aberration ~1e-8). Precondition: with abcorr 'NONE' spkcvo returns r_sun - r_sc to <= 1 m. Negative control: the geometric SRP direction is >= 100x the gated maximum away from the reference. Information: the angle after adding the predicted v_sun_perp/c. (c) Exact-ray occulter oracle: on the 1000 band samples, the exact closest approach of the straight ray (moving at c along u, ending at r_sc at t) to a uniformly moving Moon (at -v_moon s at t - s): s* = (r_sc . w)/(w . w), w = c u - v_moon, r_occ,exact = -v_moon s*; gate max |r_occ,prod - r_occ,exact| <= 0.1 m (expected ~1e-2 m: O(v/c) of the ~60 m lag). Information: WP3.1's ray_crossing_check rerun (contact shifts of the exact and the ray-crossing models, survey -0.1118 s)
gates.LT_G4_GRADIENT: RHS level, no integration, against the WP3.1 functions (a_LT = full_ray_crossing + srp_acceleration_with_lunar_shadow): (a) position gradient of a_LT (production G_r + G_SRP) against the 4-point central difference with h = 10 m, on the LT_G2 CONICAL band samples with 0 < nu_LT < 1 whose light-time and geometric lunar contact functions are all at least 1e-4 rad from zero, and on the NO_SHADOW samples: max relative Frobenius error <= 1e-6; (b) the increment's position gradient G_r in full light (shell samples in the sunward half) against the 4-point central difference of full_ray_crossing with h = 1e6 m: <= 1e-5 relative (the rounding floor of differencing a 1e-4 increment of two ~1e-8 m/s^2 accelerations is ~5e-7, reasoned before any number); (c) velocity gradient G_v against the 2-point central difference in v_sc with h = 100 m/s (da is linear in v_sc): <= 1e-6 relative on all LT_G2 samples with nu_LT > 0, and exactly zero where nu_LT = 0; (d) with the Earth shadow: on S3's E_G2 sampler (seed 20261125, Earth penumbra and umbra) with v drawn as in LT_G2, the gradient of the composed increment nu_E da against the 4-point central difference (h = 100 m) of nu_E (S3 production earth_illumination) times full_ray_crossing, on samples with 0 < nu_E < 1 whose Earth contact functions are at least 1e-4 rad from zero: <= 1e-6 relative; G_v composed: <= 1e-6
gates.LT_G5_VARIATIONAL: synthetic geometry, orbit TERM (no lunar shadow), Moon J2 (legacy), 6 h every 300 s, SRP NO_SHADOW K = 0.2, package on, production propagators at DOP853 rtol 1e-13 atol 1e-14. Oracle: S3's fixed-step RK4 (5 s) re-propagation of the PRODUCTION package-on 6-state RHS, central differences h = 3 m and 3e-3 m/s. (a) STM: max over columns of max|FD_j - Phi e_j| / max|Phi e_j| <= 1e-7. The negative control without the package's gradients is information only, not gated: G_v ~ a_SRP/c ~ 3e-15 /s and the full-light G_r ~ 1e-23 /s^2 move Phi by ~1e-10 relative over 6 h, far below the oracle floor (S3: 6.3e-8), so no control can separate them here; the gradients are verified at the RHS level by LT_G4 and LT_G5(c). (b) dK = 0.02: max|FD_K - s_K| / max|s_K| <= 1e-6; negative control: the 48-state run without the package's part of df/dK (analysis-only replica) has error >= 10x the gated error (expected ~1e-4, the aberration fraction of g). (c) RHS structure at random states (including lunar and Earth penumbrae, Earth shadow on and off), no integration: package-on minus package-off equals [0, da'] in 0:6, G_r' @ Phi[0:3, :] + G_v' @ Phi[3:6, :] in rows 3:6 of Phi_dot and G_r' @ s_K[0:3] + G_v' @ s_K[3:6] + da'_per_K in s_K_dot[3:6] (primes: composed with nu_E when the Earth shadow is on), each to 4 eps of the base element magnitude, nothing else moves; the 6-state path never evaluates a gradient
gates.LT_G6_PATH_CONSISTENCY: positions from the 6-, 42- (numba and, without harmonics, the reference) and 48-state propagations at DOP853 rtol 1e-13 atol 1e-14, 6 h, K = 0.2: their largest disagreement with the package on is <= 2x the same disagreement with the package off plus 1e-6 m (the S3 lesson: the absolute path floor is 1e-6..2e-5 m and case-dependent, so the gate is relative to the measured package-off floor of the same case), Phi agrees to <= 1e-8 of max|Phi|, and the package moves the 6-state positions by >= 1e-4 m (expected 1e-3..5e-3 m: aberration ~1.5 a t/n ~ 3e-3 m at K = 0.2, the shadow lag of the same order and opposite sign). Cases: (i) TERM, J2, NO_SHADOW, no events; (ii) as (i) with the S1 tide; (iii) TERM, S1 zonal synthetic harmonics with harmonic_stm_opt_in, NO_SHADOW; (iv) PLANE, J2, CONICAL_PENUMBRA, shadow_events; (v) real E2, default grail_pa_de440 J2, CONICAL_PENUMBRA, shadow_events, sample_ssb_velocities; (vi) synthetic eclipse PLANE, J2, CONICAL_PENUMBRA, Earth shadow on, shadow_events
gates.LT_G7_SHADOW_EVENTS: synthetic geometry, orbit PLANE, J2, SRP CONICAL_PENUMBRA K = 0.05, shadow_events True, DOP853 rtol 1e-11 atol 1e-12, T6H, package on. (a) 6-, 42- and 48-state propagations complete and the contact check passes at every cut. (b) shadow_contact_times(srp_light_time=LT) returns as many cuts as without the package, and each is within _CONTACT_TIME_TOL_S of a light-time lunar contact of the 6-state D2 trajectory (offset from the light-time contact functions). (c) every light-time cut is more than _CONTACT_TIME_TOL_S from every geometric cut, the matched shifts lie in [0.02, 0.5] s in magnitude (WP3.1: 0.11 s), and segmenting the package-on RHS at the geometric cuts raises the contact-consistency RuntimeError. (d) with the Earth shadow also on (synthetic eclipse, PLANE): the cut list holds at least 2 Earth contacts and the light-time lunar contacts, and the D2 propagations complete.
